titulo: The routine: reflexive verbs, frequency and -ir verbs: -ir verbs and a day's routine

aula.titulo: The routine: reflexive verbs, frequency and -ir verbs
aula.objetivo: Talk about your daily routine with reflexive verbs, say how often you do things, and conjugate regular -ir verbs.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: regular «-ir» verbs drop the «-ir» and take «-is, -is, -it, -issons, -issez, -issent»: «finir → je finis, tu finis, il finit, nous finissons, vous finissez, ils finissent». STEP 2: notice the «-iss-» in the plural? It sets this group apart from the irregular ones. STEP 3: pronunciation: «je finis», «tu finis» and «il finit» sound the same: «fee-NEE». Only in the plural does the sound «fee-nee-SOHN» appear (the final n is not pronounced). STEP 4: use them for actions with a result: «Je finis à six heures.» «Elle choisit un livre.» STEP 5: careful: «partir», «dormir» and «sortir» end in «-ir», but they are irregular and have no «-iss-»; they come later.
blocos.comparacao: English verbs have no groups like this («I finish», «he finishes»). French regular «-ir» verbs take «-iss-» in the plural, a feature that identifies the group.

blocos.ru: Je m'appelle Julien et je suis ingénieur. Je me réveille à six heures et demie et je me lève à sept heures. Je me lave, je m'habille et je prends le petit-déjeuner. Je prends toujours un café avec du pain. Je vais au travail en métro. Je finis à six heures. Le soir, je dîne avec ma famille et je ne me couche jamais très tard. Le week-end, je me promène souvent avec mes amis.
blocos.pt: My name is Julien and I'm an engineer. I wake up at half past six and get up at seven. I wash, get dressed and have breakfast. I always have a coffee with bread. I go to work by metro. I finish at six. In the evening, I have dinner with my family and I never go to bed very late. At the weekend, I often go for a walk with my friends.

perguntas.pergunta: À quelle heure se lève Julien ?

perguntas.resposta: Il se promène avec ses amis.

blocos.enunciado: Write and read aloud a text of six sentences about your day, using reflexive verbs, «toujours» and «finir».
Say four of your habits with adverbs of frequency.
